terminal.emulator: direct PTY with raw byte writes

reference.capture: direct PTY with SSH_TTY remote marker, synthetic xclip provider, and ST-terminated OSC52 responses

normalization: Temporary checkout, synthetic HERMES_HOME, HOME, xclip, and PTY paths are represented by placeholders.
SSH_TTY is set to a synthetic remote marker; TMUX and STY are absent so the bare OSC52 query is isolated.
ANSI control sequences, cursor placement, colors, timestamps, session IDs, prompt faces, offsets, and dynamic working-directory text are not part of this contract.
The PTY window is explicitly set to 120 columns by 40 rows before process launch.
Ctrl+V is sent as raw byte 0x16. OSC52 queries and DA1 responses are written directly to the PTY master.
ST is the exact two-byte ESC backslash terminator. The synthetic xclip provider records -selection clipboard -out and returns a case-specific native payload with one trailing newline.
A response boundary is considered ready when either the OSC52 payload or native payload is inserted and the busy interrupt marker is absent; no agent submission is allowed in these controls.

unknowns: Delayed responses after the 500 ms read race and oversized payloads were not exercised.
BEL-terminated malformed and unterminated controls are covered by OBS-0026; this fixture covers only ST-terminated valid, empty, and invalid-base64 responses.
TMUX/STY passthrough wrapping, image/path clipboard behavior, gateway behavior, concurrent input, and Hades implementation parity remain separate unknowns.
